params.val: ignores stat stage changes on both sides for damage and accuracy calculation — as attacker, ignores its own Attack/Sp. Atk boosts and the target's Defense/Sp. Def/evasion changes; as defender, ignores the attacker's Attack/Sp. Atk/accuracy changes and its own Defense/Sp. Def boosts
the holder's own stat stages still change normally and still affect anything else (e.g. Speed) — this only suppresses their effect in the specific damage/accuracy calculation described above
